description:
Nutrition per 100g or 100ml (energy, fat, carbohydrate, sugars, protein,
    salt), the ingredients list as printed (allergens included), how many
    ingredients it lists, country of origin, alcohol strength, pack size,
    description and today's price, for particular products.

    Products are looked up by product id (store-prefixed, as returned in
    product results), by the retailer's own item numbers (skus with store, as
    printed on its receipts), or by name (query). ingredients_incomplete marks
    an ingredient list on record that is cut short, which cannot show that an
    ingredient is absent. Results carry a note that nutrition and ingredients
    are for information only. Each product returned costs one credit.

    Args:
        query: product name words, e.g. "kellogg's corn flakes".
        product_ids: e.g. ["tesco:300793546", "dunnes:100873410"], up to 50.
        skus: the store's own item numbers, e.g. ["100873410"], up to 50;
            needs store. An Aldi article number can return several variants.
        store: aldi, tesco, supervalu, dunnes or lidl: required with skus,
            narrows a query; leave out for all five.
        limit: most products to return for a query (default 5, max 50).
name: get_product_details

alcohol_abv_source.description: Where the strength came from: the retailer's own listing, worked out from its alcohol units per bottle or can, or the same barcode at another store
alcohol_abv_source.title: Alcohol Abv Source

allergy_advice.description: The retailer's allergy advice, kept apart from the ingredients: what the product contains and may contain, e.g. 'Contains: Milk. May contain: Nuts.'; missing where the retailer publishes none
allergy_advice.title: Allergy Advice

ingredient_count.description: How many ingredients the label lists (a compound ingredient's own bracketed list counts as one); missing when it cannot be told reliably
ingredient_count.title: Ingredient Count

ingredients_incomplete.description: True when the list on record appears cut short, so it is not the full list and cannot show that something is absent
ingredients_incomplete.title: Ingredients Incomplete

ingredients_source.description: Where the ingredient list came from: the retailer, the same product (same barcode) at another retailer, or Open Food Facts
ingredients_source.title: Ingredients Source

nutrition_source.description: Where the nutrition values came from
nutrition_source.title: Nutrition Source

origin.description: Every country the label states, where it was made and where its main ingredient is from, e.g. 'Ireland', 'Ireland, EU, non-EU' (produced in Ireland using EU and non-EU chicken) or 'China, Spain, Argentina' for a blend; missing where none is stated
origin.title: Origin

origin_text.description: The origin statement in the source's own words
origin_text.title: Origin Text

shelf_path.description: Where the retailer shelves it, every level, e.g. 'Fresh Food > Yoghurts > Kefir > Kefir Drinks'
shelf_path.title: Shelf Path

title: Nutrition, ingredients and product details
